scope: 18 existing draft A/C/D items and earlier unapproved rewrite options. E is auxiliary; B is audited separately.

collisionDirections.problem: A currently includes changing routines/methods, D includes novelty/exploration; their newness content may overlap
collisionDirections.requiredEvidence: Distinct interpretation of 'environment change' vs 'range/depth of experiences' from responses and cognitive interviews

collisionDirections.problem: C future/current preferences can be confounded by financial/time opportunity in auxiliary E
collisionDirections.requiredEvidence: Show that resource scarcity is not interpreted as a person's long-term value

collisionDirections.problem: B2 contexts reuse change/time/novelty scenarios, potentially measuring A/C/D instead of independent self/others values
collisionDirections.requiredEvidence: Cross-domain cognitive review; compare constant wording in B2 and domain-specific value choices

collisionDirections.problem: D02/03 knowledge versus lived experience and D01/D06 hobbies versus travel can duplicate scope
collisionDirections.requiredEvidence: Discriminating evidence and content coverage review

collisionDirections.problem: C01/02/05 future-versus-now repeatedly rephrase the same choice
collisionDirections.requiredEvidence: Show added coverage rather than repeated wording
